summary: Finis & Eillert is a Dutch maker of machines and processing lines for vegetable processing, based in Ulft. For potatoes it builds destoners, peelers, slicers, halvers, profilers and inspection tables. It is a family business in its fourth generation, dates its machine production to 1925, and Finis and Eillert combined in 2011.
founded: 1925 (first factory; forerunner Technisch Bureau Finis owned by Alois van Raaij in 1917)
machines: BLADE: continuous knife or abrasive disc peeler for potatoes and root vegetables
Rollerpeeler FRS: abrasive roller peeler for peeling or pre-peeling potatoes and root vegetables
B25 Knife Peeler: peeler with hardened knives for potatoes and carrots
C25 Abrasive Peeler: peeler with a carborundum-coated interior for potatoes and carrots
APM: abrasive peeler for potatoes and other tubers, with pneumatic control of peeling time
Hydrocutter: water-pressure slicer for French fries, wedges, halves and quarters
Halver: cuts peeled potatoes into halves with a rotating circular knife
Profiler: gives potatoes a uniform rounded shape, including peeled rounded cubes (baby potatoes)
Roller Inspection Table: turns peeled potatoes on rollers so operators can inspect all sides
Destoning solutions: Stone Catcher, Vertical Auger and Cyclone De-stoners remove stones in water
markets: Agents worldwide giving support in local languages
facts: 1925: first company-owned factory opened and FINIS machine production began
2011: Finis and Eillert joined forces; Finis partly acquired Eillert
Tuberous vegetables line capacity: 400–500 kg per hour
Abrasive peeling line capacity: about 1,000–1,200 kg/hour input
